RESPONDENT PROPERTY SUBJECT TO DISPOSITION: $337.00 BE RELEASED TO MALINA MOORE ON BEHALF OF CLAIMANT GARY MOORE. CLAIMANT WAIVES CONDITION PRECEDENT TO THIS FORFEITURE. PARTIES SHALL BEAR THEIR COSTS OF SUIT AND ATTORNEY FEES. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
